params.1273: View the main interface within a clan citadel.
params.1292: This task will show you the information available for controlling clan citadels.
params.1274: Travel to your clan's citadel via the portal south of Falador.
params.1275: While you are inside the citadel, your world map will change to display the citadel you are in.
params.1276: You must be in your own clan's citadel to open this menu.
